name: Task Router
description: Classifies each message as a browser task, desktop task, or chat and switches the model for that run automatically.

browserModel.description: Model ref used when a message is classified as a browser-automation task (e.g. "together/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6"). Falls back to desktopModel when unset.

desktopModel.description: Model ref used when a message is classified as a desktop-automation task. Falls back to browserModel when unset.

chatModel.description: Cheap model ref for chat-classified runs (questions, conversation, writing). Defaults to agents.defaults.economyModel.

liteModel.description: Tiny model ref that answers trivial social messages (greetings, thanks) directly, skipping the agent loop, tool schemas, and full system prompt entirely. Defaults to agents.defaults.economyModel.

classifierModel.description: Cheap/free model ref used only when local heuristics cannot classify a message. Defaults to agents.defaults.economyModel.

stickyMinutes.description: After a session is routed to an automation model, follow-up messages keep that model for this many minutes since the last automation-classified message (default 30). Set 0 to disable.
